tagline: Draw it · Move it · Print it
headline: Designs that sell. Motion that stops the scroll.
intro: Flyers, packaging, motion ads and smudge portraits for brands that want to look premium. Based in Nigeria, working with clients everywhere.
about: ECS is a creative studio led by Eddie. From a single flyer to a full launch — print design, packaging, 3D motion ads in Blender and hand-drawn smudge art — every piece is made to make your brand look expensive and get people talking.

order_steps.title: Send your brief
order_steps.text: DM "ECS" on Instagram or WhatsApp with what you need, your logo, photos and details.

order_steps.title: Get a quote & concept
order_steps.text: You get a price, timeline and a first idea of how it will look.

order_steps.title: Review & refine
order_steps.text: We adjust colours, wording and layout until it feels right.

order_steps.title: Receive your files
order_steps.text: Print-ready files, social sizes and motion ads ready to post.
